headerDisplay: After restarting Homebridge, check the log for the web UI URL (default port: 8999). Open that address to enter the PIN shown on your TV, then use the same address to access the Channel Selector UI.

autoscan.title: Autoscan (managed TVs)
autoscan.description: When enabled, TVs added through the /discover web UI are stored in a separate managed file (plugin-persist/homebridge-bravia/tvs-managed.json) and merged with TVs in this config at load time. The plugin never modifies your config.json. On duplicates by MAC, config.json wins and a warning is logged.

discoveryRange.title: Discovery range (CIDR)
discoveryRange.description: Subnet(s) to scan from the /discover UI, e.g. '192.168.1.0/24'. Leave empty to autodetect from the local IP. Limited to /20 or smaller (4096 hosts max).

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of your TV in HomeKit

ip.title: IP / Hostname
ip.description: The IP address or host name of your TV, find or set in your router

psk.title: Pre-Shared Key (PSK)
psk.description: If set, the plugin uses PSK authentication (X-Auth-PSK header) instead of PIN+cookie pairing. Required for some Bravia XR models (interface v6.x and above). Set the same key on the TV: Settings > Network > IP control > Authentication > Pre-Shared Key.

serverPort.title: PIN entry / Channel Selector server port
serverPort.description: Port of this TV's web UI (PIN entry and Channel Selector). With more than one TV, give each TV a different port.

channelSelectorPort.title: Channel Selector port override
channelSelectorPort.description: Override the port used for the Channel Selector web UI (defaults to serverPort)

enableChannelSelector.title: Enable Channel Selector UI
enableChannelSelector.description: Controls only the Channel Selector UI page. The web server (needed for pairing) is always active.

maxInputSources.title: Max Input Sources
maxInputSources.description: Maximum number of inputs to register in HomeKit. HomeKit hard limit is 97. Defaults to 97.

mac.title: MAC address
mac.description: DO NOT set unless you need to use WOL

externalaccessory.title: External Accessory
externalaccessory.description: Workaround for multiple TVs and remote app, registers this TV as an external accessory

volumeAccessory.title: Volume Accessory
volumeAccessory.description: Expose a separate Lightbulb accessory in HomeKit to control TV volume (brightness) and mute (on/off). Defaults to false.

appsAccessory.title: Apps in a separate tile
appsAccessory.description: Show apps in their own '<name> Apps' TV tile in the Home app instead of the TV's input list (needs a one-time pairing with the Homebridge setup code). The ones ticked in the Channel Selector, or all if none. Defaults to false.

recordingsAccessory.title: Recordings in a separate tile (USB drive required)
recordingsAccessory.description: Show every recording on the TV's USB hard drive in its own '<name> Recordings' TV tile (newest first, updated automatically). Works only while a USB drive is connected to the TV and set up for recording. Defaults to false.

functionsAccessory.title: TV functions in a separate tile
functionsAccessory.description: Show TV functions (Teletext, Guide, Subtitles, Record now…) as buttons in their own '<name> Functions' accessory instead of the TV's input list. The ones ticked in the Channel Selector, or all if none. Defaults to false.

controlsAccessory.title: Controls Accessory
controlsAccessory.description: Expose a separate '<name> Controls' accessory with one switch per picture mode (switching one off returns to Auto) and a 'Screen off' switch (picture off, sound on). Defaults to false.

controlsScenes.title: Picture modes for the Controls accessory
controlsScenes.description: Picture modes exposed as switches. Default: cinema, game, sports. Your TV's modes are listed in the plugin web page (Pairing & device → Diagnostics).

volumeUI.title: Volume On-Screen Display
volumeUI.description: Show the TV's native volume slider overlay on screen when changing volume via HomeKit. Requires setAudioVolume v1.2+. Defaults to false (silent volume changes).

debug.title: Debug Log Output
debug.description: Gives additional debug output in the log

tvsource.title: TV Source
tvsource.description: Select TV input to display TV channels in the input list

applications.title: App
applications.description: Leave empty to not list TV apps in the input list, add app names to show those apps. A part of the name should suffice.

sources.title: Source
sources.description: Leave empty to let the plugin read the input list from the TV. If set, ONLY these Sony source URIs are scanned, e.g. extInput:hdmi, extInput:composite, extInput:scart, extInput:cec, extInput:widi. Do not enter input names such as HDMI 3: use the Channel Selector to pick single inputs.
